points: Bigger picture is bearish (counter-trend for a daily long)
Macro: US net liquidity contracting — caution on the odds

cycle_plain.daily_line: Daily cycle: day 68 of a typical 36–42 trading days
cycle_plain.daily_phase: overdue — past the typical window, so a low could form any day
cycle_plain.daily_line_zh: 日线周期：第 68 天，典型周期为 36–42 个交易日
cycle_plain.daily_phase_zh: 逾期——已超过典型窗口，低点随时可能形成
cycle_plain.weekly_line: Weekly (investor) cycle: week 15 of a typical 16–26 weeks
cycle_plain.weekly_phase: late — the bigger cycle is getting old
cycle_plain.weekly_line_zh: 周线（投资者）周期：第 15 周，典型周期为 16–26 周
cycle_plain.weekly_phase_zh: 晚期——更大的周期已趋于老化
cycle_plain.translation: The last cycle peaked in its FIRST half ('left-translated') — weak cycles top early, so this hints the bigger trend is tiring.
cycle_plain.translation_zh: 上一周期在前半段见顶（“左移”）——弱周期见顶偏早，这暗示更大的趋势正在走弱。

ladder.why_zh: 失败周期——价格跌破了启动本周期的低点，历史上这通常意味着更大的趋势正在掉头向下（约 80% 的情形）。 上一周期为左移结构（见顶偏早）——属于看空的结构性信号。
ladder.next_zh: 观望，直至新的日线周期低点形成并确认。
ladder.regime_line_zh: 大局：看空 — 周线动量为负；投资者周期失败（跌破起始低点）；上一周期左移（见顶偏早）（投资者周期第 15 周 · 已失败 · 日线周期于 15 天前跌破其起始低点）。

ladder.liq_line: Macro headwind: US net liquidity is contracting — buy setups have historically had worse odds and deeper drawdowns here, so demand extra confirmation and smaller size. An odds edge, not a forecast.

ladder.age_line_zh: ⏱ 下跌趋势信号于 5 个交易日前触发（约 2026-06-22），自未确认转向切换而来。 信号强度：强（评分 -90/100）。
ladder.eq_label_zh: 入场质量：偏弱卖出/离场形态（-29）
ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle high, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期高点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。
ladder.bc_line_zh: 日线 ✗ · 3日 ✗ · 周线 ✗ · 月线 —
ladder.bc_tip: Confidence this is a DURABLE, low-drawdown bottom: how near price is to the cycle low (the drawdown-depth axis) discounted when higher timeframes haven't confirmed the turn. Measured: weekly confirmation lifted the 'cycle-low held' rate ~19pp — a higher score held far more often. Risk/durability, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.bc_tip_zh: 衡量当前是否为「持久、低回撤」底部的信心：价格距周期低点的远近（回撤深度轴），并在更高周期尚未确认转向时打折。实测：周线确认使「周期低点守住」的比例提升约 19 个百分点——分数越高，低点守住的概率越大。这是风险/持久性，并非收益预测。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean down

reasons.en: puts richer than calls by -31.2 vol pts vs peers — protection strongly bid
reasons.zh: 看跌比看涨贵 -31.2 个波动点（相对同业） — 保护性看跌被大力买入

reasons.en: call-over-put richness fading vs the prior session — bid rotating to puts
reasons.zh: 看涨相对看跌的溢价较上期下降 — 买盘转向看跌

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

entry_signal.headline: Blocked — failed cycle
entry_signal.action: Downtrend — stand aside until a new cycle low forms and confirms.
entry_signal.action_zh: 下跌趋势——观望，直至新的周期低点形成并确认。

timing.next_trigger: Downtrend — stand aside until a new cycle low forms and confirms.

headline.en: Long-duration name into a restrictive, rising-real-rate regime — rate-neutral.
headline.zh: 长久期标的进入偏紧、实际利率上行的环境——利率中性。

detail.en: Own orthogonal rate (TLT) beta -0.29 ± 0.37 — low / noisy precision. Sector anchor (XLB) reads long-duration (+0.23). Inflation hedge.
detail.zh: 自身正交利率（TLT）beta -0.29 ± 0.37——精度低／噪声。 板块锚（XLB）为长久期（+0.23）。 通胀对冲。

caveat.en: Single-name secondary betas are noisy — trust the portfolio aggregate, not any one stock's rate beta (measured out-of-sample persistence ≈ 0.36).
caveat.zh: 单一个股的次级beta噪声很大——应相信组合层面的汇总，而非任何单只股票的利率beta（实测样本外持续性约0.36）。

caveat.en: Public-record alt-data convergence — the unusual-activity layer. Graded vs SPY in the Signal Intelligence ledger; weight by that track record, not a standalone trade signal.
caveat.zh: 公开记录替代数据汇聚——异常活动层。在信号情报战绩中对标普评分；据该战绩权衡，而非独立交易信号。

decision.headline: Strong name · wrong tape — wait for a base
decision.headline_zh: 强势个股 · 趋势不利 — 等待筑底
decision.gloss: Good company, bad trend — wait for it to bottom.
decision.gloss_zh: 好公司但趋势不利——等待筑底。

trust.en: Event edge: insider buying (lone FDR survivor) + earnings-surprise PEAD context + revisions — a confluence read, not a standalone alpha
trust.zh: 事件驱动优势：内部人买入（唯一通过 FDR 的因子）＋盈利超预期 PEAD 背景＋评级调整 — 综合参考，非独立超额收益

regime.en: Mixed tape — balanced momentum / earnings edge
regime.zh: 混合行情 — 动量与盈利优势均衡

timing.text: Downtrend — stand aside until a new cycle low forms and confirms.
timing.text_zh: 下跌趋势——观望，直至新的周期低点形成并确认。

decision.conflict_note: Top board rank, but timing blocks a buy now — the rank measures the name, not the moment.
decision.conflict_note_zh: 板内排名靠前，但时机阻碍当前买入——排名衡量个股，而非买入时机。

axes.label: earnings · insider · revisions
axes.label_zh: 盈利 · 内部人 · 评级调整

falsifiers.en: Narrative basket (Critical Minerals & Rare Earths) is below its long-term trend — validated drawdown gate: size down (the AI-buildout tape is rewarding leaders, not this one).
falsifiers.zh: 所属叙事篮子（关键矿产与稀土）已跌破长期趋势 — 已验证的回撤门槛：减小仓位。

trend.label: Trend
trend.value_zh: 下行 · 较200日均线 -12% · 逆势
trend.gloss: Where price sits vs its 200-day average, and how strong the trend is (ADX).
trend.gloss_zh: 价格相对200日均线的位置，以及趋势强度（ADX）。

momentum.label: Momentum
momentum.gloss_zh: 日线／3日／周线三个周期的动量方向。

rel_strength.label: Relative strength
rel_strength.value_zh: 阿尔法 z +1.57 · 行业第 7/76
rel_strength.gloss_zh: 相对行业的价格强度——参考。

valuation.label: Valuation
valuation.gloss: Cheap/rich vs the market — context, not a buy signal.
valuation.gloss_zh: 相对大盘的估值——参考，非买入信号。

quality.label: Quality
quality.gloss: Business durability — will it survive the hold.
quality.gloss_zh: 业务的持久性——能否撑过持有期。

positioning.label: Positioning
positioning.value_zh: 内部人卖出 · 做空 9% 流通
positioning.gloss: Insider buying (an edge) and short interest (a risk).
positioning.gloss_zh: 内部人买入（优势）与做空比例（风险）。

volatility.label: Risk & size
volatility.value_zh: 常见回撤 -6% · 极端 -16% · → 建议仓位 0%
volatility.gloss: Expected downside drives how big to size.
volatility.gloss_zh: 预期下行决定建议仓位大小。

macro.label: Macro exposure
macro.gloss: Rate / inflation sensitivity — context, never scored.
macro.gloss_zh: 利率／通胀敏感度——参考，不计分。

catalyst.label: Catalyst
catalyst.gloss: Next earnings date and any earnings/revision edge.
catalyst.gloss_zh: 下次财报日期与盈利／评级优势。
